# Unscii

StickMon's global ASCII and gender-symbol bitmap resource is generated
directly from the standard 8x16 Unscii bitmap data and is rendered without
scaling.

- Upstream: https://github.com/viznut/unscii
- Commit: `257b4dfeb50651510fe8b9cf4f151a148a4490e4`
- Source file: `fontfiles/unscii-16.hex`
- SHA-256: `2642c8b748fa81f24d76772d70c55faa720d98fadfec8133daf89136c5c8bfb1`
- License: Public Domain or CC0, as stated in `UPSTREAM-README.md`

This project uses `unscii-16.hex`, not the Unifont-derived
`unscii-16-full.*` files that upstream identifies as GPL-covered.
